title: Ruuhu Tedduɗo Naamniiɗo Laamu
intro: E nder defte Quraana, ina wuuri neɗɗo mo ngalu mum e ganndal mum ngonti lefol. Ooɗoo ruuhu yalti e leydi e paabi e jawdi ɓuuɓndi, tee ɓerɗe maɓɓe ina mawni e mawnikinaare. Jokku e amen nde min njuɓɓinta sirlu gooto e daartol Qur’aana ɓurngol teeŋtude, ɗo mawngu jawdi hawri e joofnirde huɓɓunde les leydi ndi jibini jawdi maɓɓe.
clues: Mi yaltii e leydi miɗo fawii e paabi ɗi nanngi gite yimɓe fof.
Miɗo joginoo jawdi mawndi e ganndal luggiɗngal, ceertungal mi e woɗɓe.
Nde nulaaɗo ari ina nodda yimɓe e Alla, mi naamndiima laamu maɓɓe e mawnikinaare.
Ɓeen wonɓe e sara am ina njuuma, ina mbiya wonde moƴƴere Alla wonaa iwdi jawdi am.
Yimɓe am ina kaawaa mawngu am, ina njiɗi hoddiro nannduɗo e am.
Sifaaaji am mawɗi ɗii njuumtaama fof e nder leydi ko jukkungo Alla.

trial.label: Ñaawoore/Kewu
options: Moftude jawdi ummoraade e leñol gonngol e heege

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Werlo nder maayo hakkunde ɓuuɓol e ɓuuɓol
Muuɗi leydi e jawdi mum fof
Ummitinaama e nguurndam haa asamaan ko maande
outcome.answer: Muuɗi leydi e jawdi mum fof

arabic: وَقَـٰرُونَ وَفِرْعَوْنَ وَهَـٰمَـٰنَ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ سَـٰبِقِينَ
verse: And [We destroyed] Qārūn and Pharaoh and Hāmān. And Moses had already come to them with clear evidences, and they were arrogant in the land, but they were not outrunners [of Our punishment]. (29:39)
